summary.ko: 실제 동작과 독자 과업을 바탕으로 실행 가능한 안내·참조 문서를 작성합니다.
summary.en: Create task-oriented documentation grounded in actual product behavior and interfaces.

exclusions: Developer release notes without instructional needs

required_inputs.description: Actual behavior, interfaces, source material, and version
Reader expertise and tasks the document must support

workflow.instruction: Choose a task guide, tutorial, reference, or explanation based on the reader’s need rather than mixing them indiscriminately.
Extract prerequisites, ordered steps, expected results, and failure recovery from verified behavior.
Write accurate examples with safe placeholder data and make version or environment assumptions explicit.
Check commands and links when possible; mark untested examples and align terminology across sections.

deliverables.name: Technical document
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Includes prerequisites, steps or reference structure, expected results, and recovery guidance

deliverables.name: Verification notes
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Distinguishes tested examples from unverified assumptions

limitations: Do not invent product capabilities, command flags, or API behavior.
A document is only current for the inspected version.
permission_boundaries: Do not run destructive examples, expose credentials, or grant system access.
Publishing to an external documentation site is a separate action.
